acceptanceCriteria: affected and corpus Playwright discovery attribute files and cases from one shared walker
a test proves an empty spec cannot explain a grep omission in affected discovery
the nested-suite and title-only top-level suite cases from TestPlaywrightListedTestsCasesMatchExecutions_TJAA_V0_021 pass through affected discovery
body: Found during V1-1231 (#801, merge 8f032d969). PlaywrightListedTests now derives per-file cases from its execution walker; collectPlaywrightListUnits, still used by affected discovery (PlaywrightDiscoveryFromList), attributes nested suite `file` values and empty specs differently. An empty spec can therefore explain a grepInvert omission in affected discovery but not in corpus discovery. See docs/build-log/2026-10-11-v1-1231-corpus-grep-omissions.md Limits.
title: affected discovery: collectPlaywrightListUnits attributes nested-suite files and empty specs differently from PlaywrightListedTests
